description:
Tobacco Pipe Lot - 8 Pieces
Peterson's and Mixed Brands, Briar Wood
Vintage Era
This collection features eight vintage estate tobacco pipes, including a notable Peterson's pipe and a commemorative 1993 Christmas pipe. The lot showcases a diverse array of traditional pipe shapes, finishes, and stem materials, representing classic mid-to-late 20th-century smoking accessories. These pieces are ideal for restoration enthusiasts or as additions to a historical smoking memorabilia collection.
Peterson's K&P estate pipe featuring a silver-tone metal band
Red-finished briar pipe marked "Christmas 1993" on the shank
Unique clear acrylic stem pipe with a blue and black swirled bowl
Various briar wood pipes including straight and bent billiard shapes
One detached vintage dark wood pipe bowl
Condition:
Stains are present throughout the lot. The bowls show significant charring and carbon buildup consistent with regular use. Plastic and vulcanite stems exhibit varying degrees of oxidation, surface scratches, and light teeth chatter. Finish wear, small nicks, and surface staining are visible on the wood surfaces. All items are sold as-is for restoration or display.

Hemingray Glass Company
No. 45 Glass Insulator
Pressed Glass, Clear, Vintage

The No. 45 model features a robust double-petticoat design intended for high-performance electrical isolation.
Double petticoat construction for electrical insulation integrity
Clear glass with a subtle light aqua tint characteristic of period glass production

description:
Unbranded
Silver-Tone Metal Smoking Pipe
Traditional Asian Style, Vintage
This ornate smoking pipe features intricate silver-tone wirework and filigree decoration throughout the bowl and stem. The design incorporates traditional Asian motifs, including butterfly-like forms and floral appliques, characteristic of Miao or Hmong metalwork traditions. The elongated, curved stem is segmented by decorative bands and applied filigree, leading to a small, structured bowl area with scrolled wire details and a hanging decorative element.
Silver-tone metal construction with hand-applied filigree and wirework decoration
Traditional Asian design featuring butterfly and floral motifs characteristic of regional metalwork
Elongated curved stem with segmented decorative bands and ring-turned finials

Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.

description:
Natural Quartz Geode
Crystal Cluster Specimen, Tan Matrix
Vintage, Approximately 4 Inches
This natural quartz geode features a hollow interior lined with sparkling clear to white crystal points. The specimen is housed within a textured, tan-colored rocky matrix that provides a beautiful contrast to the crystalline core. Geodes of this type are formed through mineral deposition within rock cavities, making each piece a unique geological treasure for collectors.
Interior cavity filled with clear quartz crystal druzy and small points
Rough, natural tan stone exterior matrix with authentic texture
Single piece specimen with flat display potential
Measurements: 4 inches L x 3 inches W x 2.5 inches H
Condition:
Natural condition with no damage to the crystal interior. The exterior matrix shows natural variations and textures inherent to raw stone specimens. No artificial coloring or treatments observed. Structurally sound for display.

Description
: Explore Earth's ancient past with this 12-piece Fossil Collection Kit, perfect for science enthusiasts and collectors alike. Each fossil is individually bagged and accompanied by an educational card describing its origin and significance, including gastropods, pelycopods, horn coral, crinoid stems, brachiopods, trilobites, dinosaur bone, ammonites, fossil wood, algae, and shark teeth. The set includes a colorful timeline card mapping major periods of prehistoric life, making it a valuable educational tool. Ideal for students, teachers, or hobbyists, these fossils offer hands-on learning about natural history and paleontology. All items shown are included, and each fossil appears in its own clear, labeled packet for easy viewing and storage. The set is presented in good visible condition, with all key contents intact and readable. Delight in the tactile experience of real fossils and enrich your educational collection or science display with this fascinating assortment.
This is a pre-owned item donated to Goodwill of Northern Michigan.
Please see images for further detail and ask any questions you may have before making a bid.
Items have been tested for power, not function. In some instances we may not have the necessary equipment to test certain electronics therefore all items will be auctioned off AS-IS with no refunds.
Items in lots are sold as-is, are not eligible for refunds, and may not be individually wrapped.
Please contact us before making payment to review combined shipping options.
Pick-Ups
We're open Monday - Friday, 8 am - 4 pm. We are closed on weekends and major holidays. For local pickup in Traverse City, please give us 24 hours from time of payment to prepare your order. Thank you!

description:
John P. Koehler
Blown Glass Cattail Sculpture
Art Glass, Agate, and Burl Wood
10" x 4" x 5"
Signed and dated 1992 on base
This intricate mixed media sculpture by artist John P. Koehler captures a stylized natural scene through a sophisticated combination of organic and artisanal materials. The work features hand-blown glass cattails accented with gold-tone luster and delicate clear glass reeds, all emerging from a base crafted from natural burl wood and polished agate geode slices. The composition reflects the studio glass movement of the late 20th century, emphasizing the contrast between the translucent, fragile nature of glass and the raw, earthy textures of stone and wood.
Features two distinct gold-flecked blown glass cattails and multiple slender glass reeds
Base constructed from a natural burl wood segment integrated with polished agate slices
Hand-signed and dated "7-1992" by the artist on the underside
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition. The glass elements are free of chips, cracks, or repairs. The burl wood and agate base are structurally sound with all components securely mounted. The signature on the underside remains clear and legible, and the four protective felt pads are present.

Description:
Elevate your decor or antique collection with this set of 5 vintage clear glass telephone pole insulators. Each piece features classic rounded shapes, thick glass construction, and embossed markings showing the 'Hemingray' name an iconic detail for collectors. The insulators show minor discoloration and wear consistent with age and previously serving functional use on utility poles. Offered as a matching set, these utility glass insulators bring industrial charm to any shelf or workspace. The heavyweight material ensures durability, while the transparency highlights their utilitarian design and historic appeal. Whether used for upcycling, display, or as conversation pieces, these insulators are a practical addition to any vintage decor. All five insulators are in used condition, with visible signs of prior use such as minor dirt, clouding, and scratches. Please review the images for individual characteristics and overall visual condition.

title: Hemingray 42 Glass Insulator Set 2 Aqua Blue Green CD 154 Made in USA Vintage
description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.

Hemingray Glass Insulators - 3 Piece Lot
Hemingray No. 12, CD 113
Aqua Blue-Green, Vintage Mid-Century
This lot features three vintage glass telegraph/telephone insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, once the world's largest manufacturer of glass insulators. The No. 12 model was a standard utility piece used extensively across North American communication lines. Today, these pieces are highly sought after by collectors for their historical significance, industrial aesthetic, and the iconic aqua color characteristic of Hemingray production.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray No. 12, Aqua, Drip Point Base - Visible base chip
Glass Insulator, Hemingray No. 12, Aqua, Drip Point Base - Minor base roughness
Glass Insulator, Hemingray No. 12, Aqua, Drip Point Base - Small skirt chips

The remaining two pieces show smaller fleabites, surface scratches, and general rim roughness along the base edges. The molded "HEMINGRAY No 12" marks remain legible on all pieces, and the glass retains its original color and clarity with typical manufacturing bubbles and mold lines.
